reuse.why: Uses getBulkBudgetCategories for the category set and existing getSheetValue/setBudget/batchMessages; the income-skip and sign rule are re-typed inline because no shared helper exists for them.

duplication.why: Repeats the `is_income === 1 && !isTrackingBudget()` skip and the expense sign flip that every month-wide action already copies, adding one more copy of each.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to setZero/set3MonthAvg and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Small and idiomatic for this file, though a change to the income rule must still be repeated across all month-wide actions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category selection goes through getBulkBudgetCategories like the other month-wide actions.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied income-skip/sign-flip lines are written the same way as in set3MonthAvg, not disguised.
